doctrine:
Scope: this worktree owns reduction of code, tests, gate work and API/binary surface through source-bound AST and control/data-flow analysis. Its plan contains only its own work. Master, GUI and audio campaigns remain in their originating worktrees. Removing their inherited rows here neither completes nor cancels them; Git and OvergoDB retain their history. Do not import another worktree's plan. The operator explicitly directed this correction after 9565ed5c.

Priority: remove the dominant repeated cost before small clone cleanups. The 9565ed5c fixture change removed25 SLOC but paid21m43.775s, executed146 packages with zero reuse;135 selected packages were uncertain. Gate result evidence:sha256:15e7ee3b6ea3bedf549635fe5507e1a8e27024f661ce074afe4d414efb3309e2 and cost evidence:sha256:d8ba3edcc06bdf10390d59e4145c39dc75c9e1499c96f3bfed059d6af42a0d1e bind the baseline. Address test-helper reach and repeated gate repository construction first, then common implementation and public surface. Rank by total repeated execution cost and maintenance burden; count complete attempts including publication. Avoid another full gate for isolated cosmetic savings.

Execution: codex-surface-lead owns this lane. Claim each integration boundary with role surface-area-reduction; keep commands and consoles in this worktree. Review existing committed implementations before writing alternatives. Port only reviewed relevant code, preserving caller migrations and local fixes; do not merge unrelated runtime, scheduling or acceptance policy. Dependencies name local producer steps, not source commits or foreign tasks. Continue by updating this plan when measured outcomes expose the next useful reduction; an empty dispatch is not completion of the broader objective.

Proof: use existing repoanalysis, codeprofile and codemanifest owners. Record changed source, build context, call/read/effect paths, independent invalidators and retained evidence. Sequence diagrams project those same facts; no separate graph authority. Missing or unresolved edges retain required coverage. Preserve independent numerical, cancellation, recovery and format oracles, fixture lifetimes and error paths. Compare complete caller migrations and net SLOC/AST, duplicate excess, exports, imports and link targets. A harness increase requires a measured total-cost benefit; renamed wrappers do not count as consolidation.

Acceptance: capability freeze enforced by structure. Each row retains its existing lower-bound checks; before closing an implementation step, use plan -setverify to bind its concrete reduction and counterexample acceptance in the owning package. No zero-match, missing-fixture or skipped-case credit. UNAVAILABLE inputs are explicit obligations to find or construct with provenance. Cheap static checks precede expensive verification; exact prior evidence is reused only when every relevant input matches. Preserve required gates and commit through their existing owner. Do not weaken acceptance or use throughput alone to declare correctness failure. Publish measured results and outstanding obligations, then return to dispatch.

items.title: Remove broad source and process reach from common test fixtures

steps.title: Remove broad source and process reach from common test fixtures
steps.rationale: First implementation: inventory all consumers of testutil's Go vocabulary scanner and modeltest process helpers. Review master's a96def5e and98cef84f code before choosing the smallest compatible port or consolidation. Preserve every vocabulary scope, literal/variable case, process protocol and numerical assertion. Prefer existing static-analysis owners or actual build contexts to another parallel helper package; if a shared owner is required, migrate all callers and delete displaced wrappers. Compare default Windows/Linux and windows modeltest closures. Freeze an unaffected expensive consumer and a genuinely affected counterexample before changing anything. Bind acceptance proving at least one real exclusion plus retained scanner/process coverage, and measure net source/import changes. Do not import master plan rows or unrelated gate policy. The current code also stages testskip.StoreAcceptance and StoreAcceptanceEnv against a removed foreign row. Their local retirement obligation is now this step: inspect their three-package callers and retained-store identity requirements, consume applicable existing fixes or replace duplicated skip controls with the existing fixture authority, and retain or retire each symbol with exact evidence. Do not suppress a missing fixture or mark foreign work complete; resolve affected fixture inputs before acceptance.

steps.title: Consolidate expensive candidate-repository setup
steps.rationale: Review12a021ad and a344bb47 against the local live graph helper and retained17-minute package cost. Share immutable discovery and compatible repository setup through one existing test owner. Do not duplicate livePackageGraph or packageInputGraph.clone. Fix partial-seed restoration before sharing mutable state: restore earlier writes when a later seed fails, attempt all restorations, release the lock on fatal/error/cancellation, and preserve skipped-test evidence through any child-process boundary. Retain negative recovery and contamination cases. Use one matched focused comparison followed by required gate evidence; do not repeatedly benchmark until favorable. Prefer deleting per-case setup and wrappers; quantify and justify any net harness growth.

items.title: Consolidate the highest-cost equivalent implementation paths

steps.title: Consolidate the highest-cost equivalent implementation paths
steps.rationale: Use the refreshed AST census, source history and retained execution records to select a coherent high-value group rather than another isolated fixture wrapper. Trace inputs, branches, errors, side effects, lifetime and outputs across every caller; distinguish shared construction from independent behavioral oracles. Review command setup, artifact binding and execution adapters before short host-test helpers. Record equivalence and counterexamples, migrate all affected callers, remove obsolete paths, and bind owning-package behavior plus measured reduction before closure. The census command is only a baseline, never sufficient acceptance. Split genuinely independent owners at dispatch; batch related migrations within one acceptance boundary.

items.title: Reduce duplicated command and API ownership

steps.title: Reduce duplicated command and API ownership
steps.rationale: Use AST call graphs and the generated manifest to identify commands or wrappers with identical execution owners and distinguish operator from internal consumers. Preserve documented flags, exit behavior, protocols and supported compatibility consumers. Prefer existing command owners and shared typed inputs; remove obsolete duplicate dispatchers and link targets with complete caller migration. Bind exact before/after executable/export counts and owner tests before closure; manifest freshness alone cannot accept removal. Avoid introducing a new command framework or changing HTTP/audio feature scope.

items.title: Prove reduced surface and repeated verification cost

steps.title: Prove reduced surface and repeated verification cost
steps.rationale: Compare source-bound package selection and actual executed/reused/failed/unstarted work against9565ed5c using retained results. Explain each exclusion and remaining invalidator; do not sum overlapping phase times or attribute unrelated host contention to this code. Publish net SLOC/AST, clone excess, exports, binaries and measured gate/acquisition changes through existing structured evidence owners. Bind a deterministic assertion of the chosen reduction and counterexamples before closure. Preserve unresolved process-exit finding evidence:sha256:d48c972c45ee19bd89d2f96db2437198c5688e4db2fe02759c7ede8ffe3f5da2 until explained; successful later runs do not prove it fixed. Propose the next high-value local slice from remaining measured costs; do not restore foreign rows or equate no current assignment with no useful work.
